reuse.why: It calls the shared assertNotLinkedElsewhere, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, but the upgrade/insert/sync/notify body is taken from linkAkahuAccount instead of being factored into a shared link routine.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is an almost line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount (about 75 lines), and downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions with only the URL and log text changed.

placement.why: Linking is in accounts/app.ts, the download is in accounts/sync.ts beside the other providers, the base URL is in server-config, and the types are in types/models, all matching the existing per-provider layout.

scope.why: Every edit serves the new provider, and the only extra is a release note.

maintainability.why: It is consistent with how the tree already adds providers, but it adds two more copies that must be kept in sync by hand. The balance branch is reused by widening the akahu condition rather than through a named property.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The tree has no shared provider-link or provider-download abstraction to go around, and the existing shared helpers are used.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (linkFintegraAccount in accounts/app.ts, downloadFintegraTransactions in accounts/sync.ts) are verbatim, not disguised.
